title: Paper, cardboard recycling rates were flat in 2025: AF&PA

sources.title: Paper, cardboard recycling rates were flat in 2025: AF&PA
sources.excerpt: Recycling rates held steady despite declines in U.S. paper and paperboard production in 2025, which illustrates the industry’s resilience, according to the American Forest & Paper Association.

title: California legislators pass key bills affecting haulers and recyclers

sources.title: California legislators pass key bills affecting haulers and recyclers
sources.excerpt: A bill that could change hauler franchise agreements, plus bills to manage medium-format batteries, vape waste, food donations and landfill temperature events, are nearing Gov. Gavin Newsom’s desk.

title: State regulators grapple with food depackaging rules

sources.title: State regulators grapple with food depackaging rules
sources.excerpt: Regulators from three states discussed the steps they’re taking to ensure depackaging equipment doesn’t add contamination to organic waste streams, during a Tuesday webinar hosted by BioCycle.

title: MIT offshoot Emvolon inks landfill-to-methanol deal with Freepoint
summary: Emvolon’s technology transforms refined landfill gas from smaller sites into methanol, a premium fuel. The company is capitalizing on growing demand for alternative fuels.

title: Oregon EPR law doesn’t violate Constitution, judge rules

sources.title: Oregon EPR law doesn’t violate Constitution, judge rules
